theme: A quiet Sunday with the girls in St. Pete.
greeting: The kids are with you and Mike at the Coffee Pot cottage. A calm day bookended by the morning board reset and the island associations' meeting tonight — and a short stack of travel bookings that have waited long enough.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: The Pathfinder heads south this month, so there's no six-seater in Maine for Christmas. A full-size SUV out of Portland over the holidays is the first thing to sell out — book refundable now and move the dates later. P1, and it's been sitting since September.

needsAttention.title: December break destination
needsAttention.detail: All four girls, Dec 13–Jan 2. The book-by date was Oct 15 and holiday inventory for six over three weeks is the thinnest of the year. Pick domestic, or lock a refundable international option, and get it booked.

needsAttention.title: Pathfinder drive south
needsAttention.detail: The Oct 5–18 off-week window to drive Portland to St Pete has closed. Settle the new plan at Sunday review — every month it slips is roughly another $950 rental cycle.

needsAttention.title: Term life quotes for Mike
needsAttention.detail: Four kids and no coverage is the real gap. Your half is the shopping — three quotes, term length, coverage amount. Still waiting on the target coverage and term to move it.

schedule.title: DIRA & DIBA annual meeting
schedule.detail: Island bridge + road associations, on Zoom

flagged.title: Toronto trip coming up
flagged.detail: An Airbnb reservation reminder for the Nov 2 Toronto stay landed — a heads-up, nothing to do.

inbox.noise: The rest was an Italian-words newsletter and a Trip.com promo.
inbox.clear: Nothing in the inbox is waiting on your reply.

recipe.title: Braised Pheasant with Mushrooms and Bacon
recipe.why: Autumn is game-and-wild-mushroom season, and a slow braise suits the cooler evenings.

tasks.title: Order the Portland house items — bedframe + outdoor soap holder

acts.line: The day opened with the fifteen-minute Sunday board reset with Mike at nine.
An open stretch at the Coffee Pot cottage with the girls — nothing else on the calendar.
The island's bridge and road associations held their annual meeting over Zoom at five.
